part: Semtech SX1281IMLTRT (LCSC C2151551, D52 BR-25; was SX1280IMLTRT C125969), U18; area-budget variant of ..._W
datasheet: Semtech SX1280/SX1281 Data Sheet DS.SX1280-1.W.APP Rev 3.2 March 2020 (${OPENDRONE_LIB}/datasheet/SX1281IMLTRT.pdf, covers SX1280IMLTRT): 17.3 Land Pattern Fig 17-3 p153 (C 4.00, X 0.30, Y 0.80, Z 4.80, G 3.20, P 0.50, H=K 2.70 EP land); body Fig 17-1 p152 (D=E 4.00, D1=E1 2.60, L 0.40, b 0.23); pins Table 2-1 p17 (exposed pad = 'pin 0', numbered 25 here as in the OpenDrone footprint/symbol)
derivation: Dense change (only one): toe shortened, outer land edge 2.40 -> 2.20 (Z 4.80 -> 4.40, 0.20 past the body edge = IPC-7351B density L toe) to meet the area budget QFN24_4 4.4 x 4.4 (DESIGN-SPEC 9.2, budget_v6, sketch_v5 SX1280 rectangle 4.4 x 4.4); heel edge kept at G/2 = 1.60 = lead heel (D/2 - L), width 0.30, pitch, EP 2.70 and paste unchanged. Safe: bottom-only terminations need no toe fillet (IPC-A-610 class 2), the joint is the lead length under the land (0.40 nominal) plus 0.20 toe; X-ray inspection as for every EP part (DESIGN-SPEC 'Exposed pads and X-ray'); no pins trimmed (none are NC)

applies_to.d52: BR-25: U18 SX1280IMLTRT -> SX1281IMLTRT (new lib symbol SX1281IMLTRT, pin-5 GND fix kept); SX1280 stays the drop-in alternate
applies_to.datasheet: the data sheet cited above is DS.SX1280-1 rev 3.2, which covers SX1280 and SX1281 (one package drawing Fig 17-1 p152, one land Fig 17-3 p153, one pin table Table 2-1 p17); the LCSC C2151551 PDF (p23/bomred_lib/dl/lcsc/C2151551.pdf) is the same document
